mechanism: Turmeric (curcumin) inhibits CYP1A2, CYP3A4, and CYP2C9 enzymes, potentially increasing propafenone plasma concentrations and cardiac effects; turmeric also has mild antiplatelet properties that may increase bleeding risk.
action: Monitor cardiac function, ECG, and propafenone levels; consider dose adjustment or spacing of administration; counsel patient on bleeding precautions.
